Game Overview

Do it up! is a action title where sprint and leap through the vibrant urban landscape of "Do it up!" with captivating parkour-style action. Master agility and timing as you navigate obstacles, always striving to reach new heights. An exhilarating journey unfolds in a world where upward movement is your only path to success.
